fees.notes: QIU does not publish programme fees on its own website; its programme pages state fees/funding are by enquiry (https://qiu.edu.my/programmes/, checked 2026-09-18). This record is mapped to QIU's ACCA Qualification, the university's accountancy professional qualification. Third-party enrolment platform Uni Enrol lists the international total fee as USD 6,213.24 over 2.5 years (USD 2,485.29/year). Source: https://unienrol.com/study-malaysia/quest-international-university-qiu/44648-association-of-chartered-certified-accountants-acca (accessed 2026-09-18).
